text: まいあさ　はやおき　して　そだてた　さなぎが！

structure.jp: まいあさ　はやおき　して
そだてた　さなぎが！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: まいあさ　はやおき　して　そだてた　さなぎ
patterns.explanation: Everything before さなぎ describes it, like 'the ... that I ...' in English. まいあさ　はやおき　して　そだてた　さなぎ = 'the pupa that I raised by getting up early every morning'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here the first action is how the second was done. はやおき　して = 'getting up early and...'.
